podcast.title: Taylor Hawkins' First Rock and Roll Gig
podcast.body: Canadian singer Sass Jordan gave Taylor Hawkins his first "rock and roll check" (paycheck) when he joined her backup band in 1994. Hawkins toured Europe with her, opening for an aerospace band, which was his initial taste of being in a touring rock band. "She gave me my first rock and roll chick. And check... Not chick, check..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Joining Sass Jordan's Backup Band (1994)
xref.body: In 1994, Taylor Hawkins secured a gig in the backup band for Canadian singer Sass Jordan after meeting someone at a music store who connected him. This opportunity allowed him to go on tour to Europe, marking his first experience in a rock and roll touring band. "Eventually he got a gig in the backup band for Canadian singer, Sass Jordan."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Drummer for Alanis Morissette (1995)
xref.body: After Alanis Morissette's "Jagged Little Pill" album blew up in 1995, Taylor Hawkins became her drummer at age 23 for her "Can't Not" tour. He appeared in several of her music videos and performed with her during her debut on David Letterman in 1995. "That Sass Jordan job morphed into a gig with Alannis Morissette."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
